messages.subject: Re: pkgconfig error installing Rhipe
parts:
One usually doesn't proceed by moving the protobuf tar ball when installing it for the front-end of a cluster.

Did you follow the protobuf install instructions from google?  I think from memory it is:
cd protobuf*
./configure  --prefix=/if/you/want/new/install/dir
make
make check
make install

Just asking up front, thanks,
Jeremiah
